description: Auto-detect common cloning features (promoters, tags, origins, resistance markers, MCS, primers) on both strands. Signatures under 20 bp must match exactly; longer ones tolerate up to ~10% mismatches so point mutants still annotate — each feature reports its own `mismatches` count and an `exact` flag.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).
